It stands along the {{ill|Minoji|fr|Minoji|ja|美濃路|qid=Q3315566}}. It is also called Nishimachi Hachiman Shrine. {{nihongo|'''Sunomata Hachiman Shrine'''|八幡神社 (大垣市墨俣町)}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki Jinmyōchō}}. It is located in {{ill|Mino Province|ckb|پارێزگای مینۆ|cs|Mino (provincie)|de|Provinz Mino|es|Provincia de Mino|eu|Mino probintzia|fa|ولایت مینو|fr|Province de Mino|gl|Provincia de Mino|hak|Mî-nùng-koet|id|Provinsi Mino|it|Mino (provincia)|ja|美濃国|ko|미노국|lt|Mino žemė|nl|Mino (provincie)|pt|Província de Mino|ru|Мино (провинция)|simple|Mino Province|sk|Mino (provincia)|sr|Провинција Мино|th|แคว้นมิโนะ|tr|Mino (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Міно|vi|Tỉnh Mino|wuu|美濃国|zh|美濃國|zh_min_nan|Mino-kok|zh_yue|美濃國|qid=Q864156|lt=Mino Province}}.

It is one of the candidate shrines for Arakata Shrine (Arakata Myōjin), a Shikinaisha in Anpachi District of {{ill|Mino Province|ckb|پارێزگای مینۆ|cs|Mino (provincie)|de|Provinz Mino|es|Provincia de Mino|eu|Mino probintzia|fa|ولایت مینو|fr|Province de Mino|gl|Provincia de Mino|hak|Mî-nùng-koet|id|Provinsi Mino|it|Mino (provincia)|ja|美濃国|ko|미노국|lt|Mino žemė|nl|Mino (provincie)|pt|Província de Mino|ru|Мино (провинция)|simple|Mino Province|sk|Mino (provincia)|sr|Провинција Мино|th|แคว้นมิโนะ|tr|Mino (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Міно|vi|Tỉnh Mino|wuu|美濃国|zh|美濃國|zh_min_nan|Mino-kok|zh_yue|美濃國|qid=Q864156}}. The other candidate shrine is {{ill|Shirahige Shrine (Q11580504)|ja|白鬚神社 (大垣市墨俣町)|qid=Q11580504|lt=Shirahige Shrine}}.

Its original location was north of the current site (the riverbed of the {{ill|Sai River (Gifu)|fa|رود سای (گیفو)|fr|Sai-gawa (Gifu)|ja|犀川 (岐阜県)|qid=Q7399814|lt=Sai River}}), and is said to have been on the border of {{ill|Motosu District, Gifu|ceb|Motosu-gun|es|Distrito de Motosu (Gifu)|fr|District de Motosu|id|Distrik Motosu, Gifu|it|Distretto di Motosu|ja|本巣郡|ko|모토스군|pl|Powiat Motosu|pt|Distrito de Motosu|uk|Повіт Мотосу|vi|Motosu (quận)|zh|本巢郡|qid=Q1204331}} and Anpachi District.

*{{ill|Emperor Ōjin|ar|الإمبراطور أوجين|arz|الامبراطور اوجين|azb|اوجین (ایمپیراتور)|bn|সম্রাট ওজিন|cs|Ódžin|de|Ōjin|es|Ōjin Tennō|eu|Ōjin enperadorea|fa|امپراتور اوجین|fi|Ōjin|fr|Ōjin|hr|Ōjin|id|Kaisar Ōjin|it|Ōjin|ja|応神天皇|ka|ოძინი|ko|오진 천황|nl|Ojin|pl|Ōjin|pt|Ojin|ru|Император Одзин|sh|Car Ōjin|simple|Emperor Ōjin|sl|Cesar Odžin|sv|Ojin|th|จักรพรรดิโอจิง|tl|Emperador Ōjin|tr|Ōjin (imparator)|uk|Імператор Одзін|uz|Imperator Ōjin|vi|Thiên hoàng Ōjin|yo|Emperor Ōjin|zh|应神天皇|zh_min_nan|Ôzin Thian-hông|zh_yue|應神天皇|qid=Q317997}}

== Transportation ==
*15 minutes on foot from "Sunomata" bus stop on the Gikaki Line of {{ill|Meihan Kintetsu Bus|ja|名阪近鉄バス|qid=Q11415818}}
**From platform 2 at {{ill|Ōgaki Station bus terminal|ja|大垣駅前バスのりば|qid=Q11433817}} (south of {{ill|Ōgaki Station|de|Bahnhof Ōgaki|eo|Stacio Ōgaki|fr|Gare d'Ōgaki|id|Stasiun Ōgaki|it|Stazione di Ōgaki|ja|大垣駅|jv|Setatsiyun Ōgaki|ko|오가키역|zh|大垣車站|qid=Q871579}}), bound for "{{ill|Gifu Shotoku Gakuen University|ja|岐阜聖徳学園大学|qid=Q5560125}}" or "Gifu Ryūtsū Center South Entrance"
*15 minutes on foot from "Sunomata" bus stop on the Obusa-Sunomata Line of {{ill|Gifu Bus|ja|岐阜乗合自動車|qid=Q5560101|lt=Gifu Bus}}
**From platform 6 at {{ill|JR Gifu Station Bus Terminal|ja|JR岐阜駅バスターミナル|qid=Q11226229}} (north of {{ill|Gifu Station|arz|محطة جيفو|de|Bahnhof Gifu|eo|Stacio Gifu|fr|Gare de Gifu|id|Stasiun Gifu|it|Stazione di Gifu|ja|岐阜駅|jv|Setatsiyun Gifu|ko|기후역|my|ဂိဖုဘူတာ|su|Stasion Gifu|ur|گیفو اسٹیشن|zh|岐阜站|qid=Q1144885}}), bound for "W65 Sunomata"
**From platform 1 at {{ill|Meitetsu Gifu stop|ja|名鉄岐阜のりば|qid=Q11415771}} (west of {{ill|Meitetsu Gifu Station|de|Bahnhof Meitetsu Gifu|eo|Stacio Meitetsu-Gifu|fr|Gare de Meitetsu Gifu|id|Stasiun Meitetsu Gifu|ja|名鉄岐阜駅|jv|Setatsiyun Meitetsu Gifu|ko|메이테쓰기후역|su|Stasion Meitetsu Gifu|ur|میٹیٹسو گفو اسٹیشن|zh|名鐵岐阜站|qid=Q1109902}}), bound for "W65 Sunomata"
